title: Faith and Truth - Episode 3: Truth That Sets You Free

parts.style: cheerful welcome, a big smile in the voice
parts.text: Hello, and welcome to Faith and Truth! <chuckle> I'm Sarah Mitchell. <short pause> And tonight is a special night... <short pause> because tonight, we're talking about being free! <long pause>

parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: So let's settle in together... <short pause> take a slow breath... <short pause> and ask a question that matters when the day is done, and you're finally still. <short pause> What does it mean to be free? <long pause>

Jesus spoke about freedom in a way that surprised the people listening. <short pause> They thought they were already free... but he was talking about a freedom they'd never known. <short pause> He said it this way. <long pause>
Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: Continue in my word. <short pause> Abide in what I have said. <short pause> That's where freedom begins, Jesus said... and it begins with truth. <long pause>

The people he was speaking to didn't understand. <short pause> They told him they were descendants of Abraham, and had never been in bondage to anyone. <short pause> But Jesus wasn't talking about politics, or family history. <short pause> He was talking about something deeper. <long pause>
And he answered them with words that cut right through to the heart of things. <long pause>
Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: Whoever commits sin... is the servant of sin. <short pause> That's the bondage Jesus was naming. <short pause> Not chains on the outside... but something binding on the inside. <long pause>
Sin makes servants of us all. <short pause> It promises freedom... and delivers the opposite. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You know what that feels like. <short pause> You say something you wish you could take back... and the regret follows you for days. <short pause> You choose what seems easy in the moment... and later you're left holding the weight of it. <short pause> You try to manage everything on your own... and the load only gets heavier. <long pause>
That's the pattern of sin. <short pause> It looks like freedom... but it binds. <long pause>

Then Jesus said something about the difference between a servant and a son. <short pause> A servant doesn't stay in the house forever... but a son does. <short pause> The servant has no lasting place. No security. No home. <short pause> But the son... belongs. <long pause>
And then Jesus said this. <short pause>
If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed. <long pause>
If the Son makes you free... you shall be free indeed. <short pause> Real freedom. Lasting freedom. It comes from Jesus himself. <long pause>
It's not freedom to do whatever you want. <short pause> It's freedom from the things that have been doing whatever they want with you. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Freedom from guilt that won't let go. <short pause> Freedom from patterns you can't seem to break. <short pause> Freedom from the fear that you're not enough... that you've gone too far... that it's too late. <long pause>

And that freedom comes through truth. <short pause> But the truth Jesus spoke of isn't just information. <short pause> It's himself... and his word. <short pause> When you abide in his word... when you continue in what he's said... you come to know the truth. <short pause> And that truth sets you free. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: So what does this mean for you tonight... as you lie here, tired, and ready for rest? <long pause>

It means you don't have to carry the weight of trying to free yourself. <short pause> You don't have to fix everything. Solve everything. Be everything. <short pause> Jesus is the one who sets you free... and he does it through his word. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Maybe tonight you're thinking about something you can't seem to shake. <short pause> A habit... a worry... a sense that you're stuck. <short pause> The way forward isn't to try harder on your own. <short pause> It's to abide in what Jesus has said. <short pause> To come back to his word, and let it speak to you. <short pause> To listen... and keep listening... and let the truth do its work. <long pause>

That work doesn't happen all at once. <short pause> Abiding means staying. Continuing. Remaining. <short pause> It's not a single moment... it's a steady practice. <short pause> You come back to his word tomorrow... and the next day... and the day after that. <short pause> And as you do, the truth sets you free... bit by bit. <long pause>
There's one more part of this passage worth holding on to tonight. <short pause> Jesus didn't just talk about freedom in the abstract. <short pause> He made it personal. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: If the Son makes you free... you are free indeed. <short pause> He's not talking about someone else. <short pause> He's talking about you. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You, with all your weariness and worry. <short pause> You, with the things you wish were different. <short pause> You, lying here in the dark... hoping for rest. <short pause> The Son can make you free. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: <exhales> So let that truth settle in... as you close your eyes. <short pause> You are not bound by what has held you. <short pause> Jesus offers freedom... real freedom... through his word. <short pause> And that freedom is yours tonight. <long pause>

Let's pray. <long pause> Lord Jesus, thank you that you are the Son who sets us free... <short pause> and that your truth isn't far from us, but near... in your word. <short pause> Help us to abide in what you have said, tonight and every day... <short pause> and to know the freedom that comes from you. <long pause>
Rest well tonight. <short pause> Goodnight.
